plan.notes: Sources (all official Bronx Community College, bcc.cuny.edu): (1) 'Computer Science (A.S. Degree) RECOMMENDED 2-YEAR ACADEMIC PLAN' term-by-term degree map, Rev. 05/31/22 — http://www.bcc.cuny.edu/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/comp-science_as_degreemap_f22.pdf ; (2) 'Computer Science (A.S. Degree) REQUIRED COMMON CORE' requirements pattern sheet, FALL 2022-SPRING 2023, Reviewed/Revised 03/24/22 — http://www.bcc.cuny.edu/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/2022_as_computersci.pdf ; (3) official course descriptions with prereqs/credit values — http://www.bcc.cuny.edu/academics/academic-departments/mathematics-and-computer-science-department/degree-certificate-courses/ . True degree name: Computer Science (A.S. Degree), Department of Mathematics and Computer Science; program articulates with the Computer Science B.S. at Lehman College and B.A./B.S. at Iona College. The f22 degree map is the LATEST official term-by-term CS sequence published by BCC (newer uploads on the BCC site are for the separate Computer Information Systems AAS program); catalog_year is the source's actual academic year, 2022-2023. Transcription method: semester sequence transcribed directly from the degree map's printed semester blocks, titles and credit values cross-checked against the pattern sheet and official course descriptions; CSI 30 confirmed at 3 credits via the winter/summer subtotal (MTH 30 4 cr + CSI 30 3 cr = printed subtotal 7). Standard placement path transcribed (MTH 28/28.5 required): map footnote 3 variants documented in choice notes. Printed term subtotals (12+7+14+14+13) sum to the map's published TOTAL of 60, which matches the catalog degree minimum of 60 — no discrepancy. Free Elective slot carries 0 credits for the standard path (footnote 3: reduced to 0 when MTH 28/28.5 and MTH 30 are required); required_zero:true set. Official term labels mapped: SEMESTER I = Fall Year 1, WINTER/SUMMER SESSION = Winter/Summer Year 1, SEMESTER II = Spring Year 1, SEMESTER III = Fall Year 2, SEMESTER IV = Spring Year 2. Remedial/ESL sequences (ENG 1/2, RDL 1/2, MTH 1/5/6, ESL 1-3, ENG 9) are 0-credit conditional items and were not transcribed. Course prereqs are the official catalog prereqs; CUNY English Proficiency is a placement status (not a course code) and the MTH 31 corequisite on CSI 31 is documented in the course note rather than the prereq list.
